title: Microsoft SkillOpt: make AI agents smarter — without training the model #anthropic #aicoding #ainews
description:
Microsoft just dropped SkillOpt — a way to make AI agents dramatically better without touching the model. Instead of retraining, it treats a single Markdown skill file (best_skill.md) as the thing you optimize, while the model stays completely frozen.
The results: best-or-tied across all 52 evaluation cells, GPT 5.5 lifted from 58.8 to 82.3, and Claude Code boosted by over 19 points — no GPUs, no fine-tuning, and it's open source.
Code: github.com/microsoft/SkillOpt
Full breakdown: advaitai.substack.com
#AI #AIAgents #Microsoft #MachineLearning #OpenSource #LLM
